verdict.rationale: Algolia's search analytics docs name all three metrics in the story: popular searches, no-result searches, and click-through rates. The docs also cover a dashboard with period comparison, CSV/XLSX export, and inclusion of replica indices. A community user independently praises the analytics for tying queries to purchases. Missing for 10: the pack does not document what click-through tracking needs (sending click events, mentioned only for Shopify/BigCommerce), and no independent account specifically confirms the no-result-query reporting.
